title: Dubai Kizomba Fusion
description:
𝗗𝗨𝗕𝗔𝗜 𝗞𝗜𝗭𝗢𝗠𝗕𝗔 𝗙𝗨𝗦𝗜𝗢𝗡 returns for its 7th edition — independent and true to its original vision.
🗓 𝟭𝟰–𝟭𝟴 𝗝𝗮𝗻𝘂𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟳
🔥 7th Edition
🇦🇪Dubai-born. Community-built since 2020.
An 𝗮𝗹𝗹-𝗶𝗻-𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗳𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗮𝗹 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 bringing together styles, cultures, and souls. A global meeting point for dancers who value connection, music, and experience, DKF 7 brings together world-class artists, DJs, and a community built over years.
From workshops to social nights and immersive experiences across Dubai, every detail is refined to deliver the standard the festival is known for.
